entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: One of the four main city-states of the Sun Empire on Ixalan, known for stone temples and ruled by its priesthood.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Ixalan to which Otepec belongs.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: Apex priestess of the Threefold Sun who ruled Otepec.

events.summary: The invasion reaches Otepec via refugees hiding sleeper agents, who activate inside the city.
events.quote: hid sleeper agents , who activated once they were inside the city, sowing chaos

events.summary: The city burns but the temples and the people sheltering in them survive.
events.quote: Though the city around them burned to cinders, the temples — and the people taking refuge within them — survived.

relations.quote: Otepec was ruled by Caztaca Huicintli
Otepec is one of the four main city-states of the Sun Empire
